inputs.name: Average members, base year
Do-nothing growth in members (existing 46-club estate)
inputs.source: Market-growth outlook for a mature estate: members per club 2.58k (2019) vs 2.61k (2024) = flat like-for-like; European memberships +5.8% in 2025 (Deloitte/EuropeActive EHFMR 2026, via Athletech News) used as the high end less new-club openings
inputs.history_note: History (CAGR 4.1%, median YoY 10.9% 2019-24) mixes the COVID rebound (2021-22) and 8 new clubs (+21% estate); the do-nothing case keeps the 46 existing clubs, whose members per club are already at the 2.6k mature level, so growth is market-like (~1%).

inputs.name: Dynamic pricing: peak uplift in average monthly fee (net of volume loss)
inputs.source: Reference class of revenue gains from dynamic vs static pricing (perishable-capacity services); a gym fee reprices only joiners and off-peak tiers, so the base is set near p25-median rather than the hotel/ticket median
inputs.bench_source: reference class n = 7: ticket simulation without learning 3.3% and 4.3%, with learning 8.15% (Phumchusri & Swann 2014); hotel RM vs static 3-5% (~4%, Numdam RAIRO overview); SF Giants dynamic ticketing +7% (2010); golf time-based pricing +12%; spa slot pricing +18% (vendor). p25 4.15%, median 7%, p75 10%

inputs.name: Reduce churn: relative cut in monthly churn at full effect
inputs.source: Reference class mostly vendor case studies (biased upward) plus one RCT with no renewal effect; base set between p25 and median. Forza's own churn fell 4.4% -> 3.9% (-11%) in 2022-24
inputs.bench_source: reference class n = 6 relative churn cuts: weekly e-mail reminders RCT, no renewal effect 0% (Tinbergen, limited attention at the gym); payment-failure workflow -12% of involuntary churn (~25% of total) ~3%; group exercisers 26% less likely to cancel (Worcester, correlational); 3-site chain -12 pp on ~40% annual (~30%); onboarding/outreach vendor case 28% -> 17% annual (-38%); BJJ gym 8% -> 4% monthly (-50%). p25 8.75%, median 28%, p75 36%

initiatives.name: App & online classes
initiatives.mechanism: Launch Forza app with live/on-demand classes -> members (and lapsed members) buy a paid digital add-on -> new digital subscription revenue

initiatives.name: Dynamic pricing
initiatives.mechanism: Time-of-day / demand-based fees for joiners and off-peak tiers -> higher average yield per member -> monthly fee

initiatives.name: Reduce churn
initiatives.mechanism: Onboarding, early-warning outreach, payment-failure recovery -> lower monthly churn -> more average members (steady state cut/(1-cut))

initiatives.name: Corporate wellness deals
initiatives.mechanism: Sign employers in the catchments -> employees join at a corporate rate -> new corporate members

initiatives.name: New clubs in the South
initiatives.mechanism: Open Forza mid-price clubs in Southern cities -> new members at Southern prices -> new club revenue

initiatives.name: Budget sub-brand
initiatives.mechanism: Open low-cost clubs under a new brand (Basic-Fit format) -> price-sensitive members not served today -> new budget revenue
